title: AquaMaps habitat suitability, native 0.5 degree
description: AquaMaps relative environmental suitability (1-100 percent) for 17,499 aquatic species on the original global 0.5 degree grid, drawn from the native COGs that MarineSensitivity release v7 publishes. The COGs are referenced, not copied; one registry row per species lets an app build a per-taxon COG Item without 17,000 Item files. Distinct from the 0.05 degree downscaled AquaMaps in the MarineSensitivity v7 collection. Non-commercial use only (CC BY-NC 3.0). Methods and registry columns: README.md.
sci:citation: Kaschner, K., Kesner-Reyes, K., Garilao, C., Segschneider, J., Rius-Barile, J., Rees, T., Froese, R. (2019). AquaMaps: Predicted range maps for aquatic species. World wide web electronic publication, www.aquamaps.org, Version 10/2019.

providers.name: MarineSensitivity

atlas:note: Non-commercial use only (CC BY-NC 3.0). Maps and numbers come from AquaMaps; link back to aquamaps.org when you reuse them.
sdm:method_detail: AquaMaps relative environmental suitability: per species, an envelope of the cell values of six predictors, fitted to occurrence records and expert-checked; published to 0.01 and stored here as Byte 1-100 (0 = no data) on the 0.5 degree HCAF grid.

atlas:item_template.description: Build one Item per registry row, client-side; no Item files are published. Substitute each placeholder in braces with the row's value of the column of that name; omit keys whose value is null.
